config.squ_abyssal_bloom.template: This is a template for the mod configuration options.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.server.tooltip: These settings are synced with the server and require operator permissions to modify.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.server.no_permi: You do not have permission to modify this part of the config
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.visual.tooltip: Visual and rendering settings, applied locally.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.fog.desc: These settings control the underwater darkness effect, which simulates the lack of light in deep underwater environments.
Enable progressive darkness when descending deep underwater
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.abyssDepthStart: Depth in blocks where the abyss effect begins
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.abyssMaxDepth.t: Depth in blocks where the abyss effect reaches its maximum darkness
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fogDarknessInte: Multiplier for the aggressiveness of the fog shrinking at depth
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.enableDepthVign: Enables or disables the dark vignette effect on the edges of the screen when exploring great depths.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.vignetteIntensi: Controls the opacity and overall intensity of the abyssal vignette on the screen.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.lightDimmingStr: Determines how much ambient light and fog darken when descending into the abyss.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.abyssColorReten: Sets the percentage of the biome's natural water color that is kept in the darkness of the abyss.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.marine_sn: Controls the appearance and behavior of marine snow particles underwater.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.maxMarinSnowPar: Defines the maximum number of marine snow particles visible underwater
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.marineSnowDensi: Multiplier for the number of marine snow particles generated per tick
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.marineSnowVisib: Horizontal radius in blocks within which marine snow particles appear
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.marineSnowSwayA: Adjusts the horizontal sway amplitude of marine snow particles.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.marineSnowSpawn: Sets the height above the player where marine snow begins to spawn.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.nautilusLampInf: To what extent a nearby Nautilus with a lamp reduces the darkness of the abyss
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.lampNearPlaneMu: Determines how strongly the Nautilus Lamp pushes back the starting point of the abyssal fog near you.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.lampFarPlaneMul: Determines how strongly the Nautilus Lamp pushes back the limit of total opacity of the abyssal fog in the distance.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.conduit.d: Settings for the particle ring indicating the limit of a conduit's effect range. Manages activation, trigger distance, dimensions, and density of the visual display.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.conduitBoundary: Enables or disables the visual display (particles) marking the boundary of a conduit's domain.
Distance (in blocks) at which the warning ring appears when you approach the limit of a conduit's domain.
Sets the radius size of the particle ring indicating the conduit boundary.
The number of particles used to draw the conduit boundary ring. A higher value results in a denser ring.
The interval (in ticks) between each spawn of the conduit boundary warning particles.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.surface_o:
Visually darkens the surface of the water.

Warning: This option may impact your FPS (performance drop) when in deep oceans.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.enableSurfaceOc: Enables or disables the darkening of deep waters when viewed from above.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.surfaceOccluder: Base opacity of the layers closest to the surface. A higher value makes shallow water darker.
Maximum opacity reached by the deepest layers. Controls how opaque deep waters can become.
Number of superimposed layers to build the darkness gradient. More layers = smoother transition but more performance intensive.
Speed at which details gradually appear when you enter a new area. A low value results in a slow fade.
Width in blocks of the level of detail bands. A larger value reduces calculations by merging distant tiles but with reduced precision.
Position of the maximum darkness depth (the last vertical band) between Abyss Start (0%) and Max Depth (100%). At 50%, maximum darkness is reached halfway between the two.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.entity.de: These settings configure the behavior of entities related to the Abyssal Bloom mod. Adjusting these settings can affect how these entities spawn and interact with the world.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.strictBarnacleS: Prevents Barnacles from other mods from spawning if enabled
Prevents entities from other mods whose name contains 'barnacle' from spawning.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.barnacle.desc: Barnacles are hostile aquatic mobs that spawn in deep underwater areas. They are known for their large mouths that can open to swallow players and other entities. They also have a hatred towards Guardians and will aggressively attack if they see one nearby.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.barnacleSpawnMa: Highest Y level at which Barnacles can spawn naturally.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.barnacleDetecti: Maximum distance in blocks at which a Barnacle can detect prey.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.barnacleMovemen: Maximum rush speed used while pursuing prey.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.barnacleObstacl: Maximum movement speed while the Barnacle follows a path around obstacles.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.barnacleFleeSpe: Maximum speed of a critically injured Barnacle while fleeing.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.barnacleRegenCo: Number of ticks out of combat between Barnacle regeneration pulses.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.barnacleDirectC: Distance at which a Barnacle can leave its path when the direct aquatic corridor is clear.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.barnacleCapture: Maximum distance at which the Barnacle can begin opening its mouth to capture prey.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.barnacleHoldDis: Distance at which captured prey is held in front of the Barnacle.
Ghost Chimaeras are ethereal aquatic mobs that spawn in deep underwater areas. They are neutral and will only attack if provoked. Ghost Chimaeras are translucent and have a ghostly appearance, remaining invisible for most of their time patiently waiting for their next prey.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.brine.desc:
Brines are dense clusters of bubbles wandering at the bottom of the oceans. They attack either by projecting bubbles directly at their target, creating a vortex above themselves while bombarding their surroundings with bubbles, or throwing their bubbles directly at the player. 

Fragile: any exposure to air is fatal to them.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.brineNaturalSpa: Allows Brines to spawn naturally in deep ocean biomes.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.brineDetectionR: Maximum distance in blocks at which a Brine can detect players.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.brineFollowSpee: Horizontal speed used while following a player.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.brineAttackSpee: Horizontal speed used while positioning for an attack.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.brineAttackEnte: Horizontal distance at which a Brine switches from following to attacking.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.brineAttackExit: Horizontal distance beyond which a Brine leaves its current attack behavior.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.brineColumnAtta: Number of ticks between projectiles during the bubble-column attack.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.brineDirectAtta: Number of ticks between direct bubble projectiles.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.red_slobberer.d: Red Slobberers are peaceful giant marine gastropods. Groups graze on Blood Seagrass and gradually support a living reef and nearby fish schools.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.redSlobbererRee: Shows reef anchors, deposits and active fish refuges with particles, and writes diagnostic lines to the server log.
Number of ticks a group must remain in an area before its local reef becomes mature.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.redSlobbererMax: Maximum local fish population maintained by a mature Red Slobberer reef.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.redSlobbererDep: Minimum number of ticks between two calcareous deposit checks for the same reef.
Maximum number of ticks between two calcareous deposit checks for the same reef.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.redSlobbererMax: Hard limit for the number of tracked calcareous deposits around one reef.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.redSlobbererMin: Minimum collective stability required for the reef to mature and produce calcareous deposits.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.redSlobbererDep: Base probability that one existing deposit gains an age during a deposit check.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.redSlobbererNew: Base probability that a mature reef attempts to place a new deposit during a deposit check.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.redSlobbererFis: Maximum distance at which a fish from the same reef may choose a Red Slobberer as shelter.
Maximum number of fish one Red Slobberer can hide in its refuge at once.
Minimum time a fish remains hidden after entering the refuge.
Maximum time a fish can remain hidden, even while danger persists.
Time without a nearby threat before hidden fish may emerge.
Time during which a damaged Red Slobberer cannot accept fish into its refuge.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.redSlobbererRee: Radius around the reef anchor in which Red Slobberers naturally wander and look for food.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.fish_scho: Controls local, leaderless collective movement. Solitary fish retain their complete vanilla AI.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolDebug: Displays collective-state particles, neighbor links and steering vectors, and writes a summary to the server log every five seconds.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolNeigh: Maximum number of nearest compatible fish used by each fish for local steering.
Maximum distance used to discover potential neighbors before selecting the nearest ones.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolAggre: Maximum distance for a weak temporary attraction that allows nearby collective schools to meet and merge.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolCross: Relative influence of compatible fish from another species. Lower values favor members of the same species without preventing mixed schools.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolActiv: Nearby compatible fish required before collective movement can activate.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolDeact: Collective movement returns to vanilla AI when the nearby fish count stays at or below this value.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolActiv: Ticks for which the activation density must remain stable before collective movement starts.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolDeact: Ticks for which density must remain too low before vanilla movement fully resumes.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolNeigh: Ticks between staggered searches for local neighbors, threats and influences.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolSepar: Strength with which fish avoid crowding and anticipated collisions with nearby fish.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolAlign: Strength with which fish progressively align with the real movement of their local neighbors.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolCohes: Strength attracting fish toward the local center of only their nearest neighbors.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolObsta: Strength of progressive avoidance for nearby blocks, narrow passages and large entities.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolThrea: Strength of the escape direction carried by a fish's local threat signal.
Distance in blocks at which an individual fish can directly detect a threat.
Fraction of a local threat signal passed from one fish to its topological neighbors.
Threat-signal intensity lost per tick once direct danger is no longer detected.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolMaxim: Maximum configured speed used during normal collective movement.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolPanic: Maximum speed approached while a fish carries a strong local threat signal.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolMaxim: Maximum horizontal direction and visual rotation change in degrees per tick.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.fishSchoolVerti: Maximum vertical speed of the slow shared depth current that lets whole schools rise and sink over time. Zero keeps schools at a constant depth.
Relative influence of non-obstacle vertical steering. Lower values keep trajectories mostly horizontal.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.ocean_ter: Manage territorial competition between mods for ocean biome generation.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.oceanTerritoryE: Size of ocean territories per mod. Higher value means larger territories.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.oceanTerritoryD: Default weight of an unknown namespace in territorial competition.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.oceanTerritoryO: Weight of Abyssal Bloom in territorial competition relative to the default weight.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.oceanTerritoryI: If disabled, vanilla ocean biomes act as a safety net rather than competing with mods for territory.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.worldgen.toolti: Controls the shape of the abyssal ocean terrain. Requires a new world to take effect.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.ocean_zon: Continentality thresholds for the three ocean zones. Requires a new world to take effect.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.shallowDeepBoun: Continentality threshold between the shallow ocean and the deep ocean. Vanilla uses -0.455.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.deepAbyssalBoun: Continentality threshold between the deep zone and the abyssal zone.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.terrain_z: Base Y heights targeted by each ocean zone. These are averages: noise and biome variations will raise or lower the actual floor around these values.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.shallowFloorY.d: Central Y height targeted by the shallow water floor.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.deepFloorTarget: Central Y height targeted by the deep water floor.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.targetFloorY.de: Central Y height targeted by the abyssal water floor.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.shallowClearanc: Minimum water column (in blocks) maintained above the shallow floor. Prevents floors from breaking the surface.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.topo.desc: Noise amplitudes shaping the abyssal floor. Each layer adds structure at a different scale: from large expanses to the finest surface details.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.warpAmp.desc: Warps the coordinate space before sampling the terrain noise. High values change the landscape into more winding and organic shapes.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.warp2Amp.desc: A second, finer warp overlaid on the first. Adds additional curves.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.topoLargeAmp.de: Amplitude of the largest topographic features: the large elevations and basins that define the overall shape of the abyss.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.topoAmp.desc: Intermediate relief overlaid on large features. Responsible for hills and valleys within each basin.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.topoMidAmp.desc: Fine variation that adds diversity and roughness to the terrain surface. Reduces the smooth look on the flattest sections.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.wallAmp.desc: Controls the height of ridge and wall formations. Never digs into the ground as it only raises it.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.detailAmp.desc: Small scale surface noise that breaks up the flatness of abyssal plains.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.microAmp.desc: The finest variation, like sediment texture on the seafloor. Subtle, but noticeable up close.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.weirdnessAmp.de: To what extent the Minecraft climate weirdness parameter warps the abyssal floor. High values tie depth more strongly to biome variations.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.group.faults.de: Tectonic fractures that vertically shift sections of the seafloor, creating sudden cliffs or steps.
Controls the frequency of faults. Lower values spread more faults across the floor.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.faultBlend.desc: Smoothness of the transition at a fault edge. A low value produces steeper and sharper cliffs.
Maximum height difference (in blocks) between the two sides of a fault. Increase for larger step formations.
Deep gashes in the abyssal floor. Trenches are the lowest points in the ocean, plunging below the standard abyssal depth.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.trenchThreshold: Frequency of trench generation. Closer to 1.0 = few, isolated trenches.
Maximum depth a trench can reach below the surrounding abyssal floor. Actual depth depends on the position within the trench.
Stepped ledges carved into abyssal slopes. They only appear in certain areas and give cliffs a layered geological look.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.terraceMaskThre: Controls what proportion of abyssal slopes can develop terraces. High values restrict them to rare areas.
config.squ_abyssal_bloom.terraceStep.des: Vertical height in blocks of each terrace step.
